faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BOI Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for Bank of India Faculty posts is 25 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications reach the specified address by this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in BOI Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Faculty post in the Bank of India Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position for supporting staff.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the BOI Faculty post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Faculty post should be a minimum of 22 years old and a maximum of 40 years old. Age will be calculated as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Faculty position at Bank of India?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Faculty position will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month. Terms and conditions may apply as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for BOI Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Bank of India Faculty Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Faculty post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Faculty post is a Graduate degree. For detailed eligibility, candidates are advised to refer to the official website.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I download the application form for BOI Faculty?
faq.answer: The application form along with the detailed notification can be downloaded from the official website of Bank of India, which is www.bankofindia.bank.in, under the "Career" section.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee details are mentioned in the official notification for the BOI Faculty Recruitment 2026. Candidates should confirm this from the detailed PDF.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Faculty position?
faq.answer: The Faculty position at Bank of India is a Contractual job type. This recruitment is for the engagement of supporting staff for RSETI.

faq.question: Q10. Which state and city is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment drive for the Faculty post by Bank of India is for the state of Jharkhand, specifically in the city of Bokaro, with pincode 827004.
